purpose: FLEET FIRST-PRINCIPLES CANDIDATES — vessel-AGNOSTIC, transferable patterns recognized during ingestion. NOT vessel-specific facts. Each candidate is a general rule proposed for the fleet log; promoted to a confirmed convention only after engineer review. Once confirmed, a Case-B equipment-pattern (DISTINGUISHING EQUIPMENT-PATTERN INFERENCE FROM IDENTITY CONFLICT protocol) may be acted on directly on future vessels; until then it only surfaces on the confirmation list.

candidates.pattern: under-differentiated node holding a conventional equipment pair (captive winch + captive tensioner as the seed instance)

detection_rule.trigger: WHEN the folder-walk produced ONE node, AND the authoritative function table (hydraulic function list / electrical load list / equipment inventory) lists TWO OR MORE functions routing to that one node, AND each of those functions names a DISTINCT make+model, AND the pair matches a recognized equipment-pair convention for the equipment class (below) -> SPLIT into one per-model node each, automatically, citing both sources in each node's identity_resolution provenance (decision='pattern_split', convention=<id>).
all_of: >=2 functions in the authoritative table route to it
each function names its OWN distinct make+model (not just an assumption there is one)
the (function-role-A, function-role-B) pair matches a convention entry in `equipment_pair_conventions` below
detection_rule.else: if ANY condition fails (only one model, no distinct model per function, pair not a recognized convention) -> DO NOT split; surface on the engineer confirmation list as multi_model. Never guess.
detection_rule.action_on_trigger: split; write identity_resolution.decision='pattern_split' on each new node with both sources; record convention id
detection_rule.confidence_floor: all_of must be fully satisfied — this is a hard gate, not a score

candidates.current_disposition: NOT yet a confirmed convention -> for gelliceaux_001 the node was NOT split; surfaced on the confirmation list (cf-001). The RULE above is what lets Engo recognize the pattern on vessel #2 without an engineer pointing it out — once this candidate is engineer-confirmed and the convention added to the functional-equipment list.
